In traditional way, centralized control is commonly adopted for active power allocation, in which, total power reference is dispatched to every wind turbine by a central controller. However, it has several disadvantages, such as complex computation and low flexibility, especially for wind farms with large number of wind turbines. Therefore, a Multi-Agent based collaboration control strategy for active power dispatching in wind farms is proposed to improve operation performance. Firstly, a Multi-Agent based control structure for wind farm is designed, which includes wind turbine agent, group manager agent and central manager agent. Secondly, coordination control strategy among different agents is designed in detail. Finally, a Multi-Agent control model of wind farm is established based on java/jade platform, and simulation results verify the efficiency of strategy proposed.

articleTitle: Optimal scheduling of the orderly power utilization in China
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: In China, the orderly power utilization management has become one of the most important way to overcome emergent events caused by power insufficiency or renewable power volatility. For the purpose of ensuing residents' and important organizations' electricity usage when emergencies come, a huge range of factories and corporations are scheduled by the orderly power utilization management to decrease their load. However, the traditional scheduling for orderly power utilization is neither economical nor clean, because it does not differentiate factories and corporations according to their financial states and pollution to the environment. This paper proposes an optimal scheduling method for orderly power utilization to minimize the financial loss burdened by participating customers and pollution to the environment as well. In the method, demand sides' response abilities is first simplified as virtual generation resources, and then the insufficient power is regarded as virtual load required to supply, finally through an optimization algorithm the virtual generation resources are dispatched taking into account their financial state and cleanness of production. The case study in Jiangsu province of China shows a huge improvement in the economy and cleanness of orderly power utilization, thus providing a powerful and green alternative to supporting economic development in China.

articleTitle: Studies on high-frequency generator tripping strategy for sending system of wind-PV-thermal-bundled power transmitted by HVDC
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: Large scale of new energy, such as wind and PV power, transmitted by long-distance and large-capacity HVDC, will make the frequency characteristics become more complex. On the high-frequency issue in Ningxia provincial wind-PV-thermal-bundled power grid when DC block and system separation cascading faults happen, the influence of largescale new energy integration on frequency characteristics is analysed. Furthermore, the problems caused by wind-PV-thermal units unordered tripping are assessed, and the corresponding tripping principles are proposed. Finally, based on the supposed principle, a new wind-PV-thermal power-combined high-frequency generator tripping strategy is proposed, which is adaptive to new energy fluctuation system. The effectiveness of the proposed strategy is simulated, and its adaptability is proved.

articleTitle: Managing the impact of intermittent generation on power system operation
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: This paper discusses the implications of the intermittency of wind and solar generation on power system operation and conventional generation. The analysis is based on modelling using actual half hour demand and wind generation output records extrapolated by zone to maintain the effect of diversity. It discusses and quantifies: The need to curtail renewable generation output at times of light load to meet system operation requirements to retain reserve and accommodate inflexible; The capacity contribution that can be credited to renewable sources towards meeting peak demands assessed on a probability basis; The impact on the operating costs and emissions from conventional generation in operating less efficiently at part load balancing renewable generation output. The impact on the utilisation and financial viability of marginal generation; The evaluation of alternative methods for balancing intermittent renewable generation output including using interconnection to access remote hydro and comparing the use of gas turbines with storage systems; The implications to the transmission system costs and losses associated with remote renewable installations with limited utilisation; The optimal generation mix and the scope for a proportion of generation with Carbon Capture and Storage (CCS) based on an LP formulation. The analysis is based on recent consultancy projects undertaken for government agencies.

articleTitle: Comparative analyses of DC collection grid based power converter topologies for offshore wind farm
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: High voltage direct current (HVDC) system has gained number of applications in offshore wind farm, and the majority of studies that are being conducted on the HVDC system focus most on the transmission line; where HVDC contributes efficiently to power conditioning, compensation, and power filtering. This paper investigates the use of DC system for the design of power generating plant of the offshore wind farm; or DC collection grid for a wind farm. Recent studies have contributed a lot in this direction. A DC collection grid system can be provided through series or parallel interconnection of wind energy conversion units (WECUs); each conversion unit includes a wind-turbine-generator and a power converter. The studies that are being done on the design of DC collection grid for wind farm use the full-bridge voltage source converter (VSC) as the topology of power converter. This paper describes some advantages and drawbacks of using the full-bridge VSC layout. The paper proposes another topology which is the single-controlled-switch converter. Comparison of these systems is done in terms of control performance and power loss. The dynamics of the WECU circuits is modelled and analysed. Power Simulator (PSim) and Matlab software are used to test the results.

articleTitle: Damping torque analysis of power systems with DFIG wind turbine generators
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: Renewable energy resources are increasingly being used to meet electric power demands and are gradually replacing conventional generation. In particular, wind generation using variable speed wind turbines (VSWT) which include doublyfed induction generator (DFIG) technology, can not only be adjusted by the amplitude and phase of rotor excitation current but also by active and reactive power independently. The purpose of the former adjustment is to maintain a constant frequency power output which can help to improve system operating efficiency and achieve higher quality power generation, while the latter adjustment can change the power angle in order to keep a stable operation of the generator. An important aspect of instability is the lack of damping to the low-frequency power oscillations in the system, which can be influenced by grid-connected DFIG wind turbine generators. In this paper, damping torque analysis (DTA) is applied to the established Phillips-Heffron model to examine the dynamic interaction between DFIG units and synchronous generators, in particular investigating how DFIGs may affect system oscillation modes. An analysis of the impact of the penetration of DFIG technology on power system stability is presented in the paper and this is exemplified by several interesting application studies and results.

articleTitle: Analysis of the stability control of wind turbines generator system based on the Lure Lyapunov function
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: In order to determine the stability regions of wind turbine generators in the process of operation, and make wind turbine generators can be faster to stable through add some necessary control link (as V function). In this paper, theorems and applications of the Lure Lyapunov function are given, the generalized mathematical model of tower system are established by a series of physical analysis and mathematical derivation. So we can obtain improved V function of tower system and get the security and stability regions in operation and take stability control, the stable operation regions of the wind turbines can be got. Obtained the tower transfer function by the state space equation, and through the impulse response of the transfer function that add a new control link by the Lyapunov function to optimize the stability and controllability of WTGs in the process of operation, determined the safety threshold constant S and the critical threshold constant γ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</sub>, given the V function control optimization case of 1.5 MW wind turbines, prove the application value of the Lyapunov function in the stable operation of wind turbines, theoretically provides a sufficient condition for the strict judgment stability of the WTGs.

articleTitle: Method for estimating unbalanced currents in untransposed double-circuit lines on the same tower
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: Due to the technique and economic considerations, transmission lines in the power grid are usually untransposed, which leads to the result that the line parameter is asymmetric. For double-circuit lines on the same tower, asymmetric line parameters may cause unbalanced currents even under normal operation, which will have a negative impact on the line temperature, line loss and even relay protections. This paper firstly investigates the line parameters and current characteristics of the double-circuit lines on the same tower under normal operating mode. Then, we provide a method to analyze the current characteristics including circulating current and the net through current, and effects of phasing arrangement on each kind of unbalanced components are analyzed. Finally, based on the actual parameter of tower and transmission line in power grid, unbalanced currents of a certain double-circuit line are analyzed with full consideration of different phasing arrangements. With the help of analysis results, some useful conclusions and suggestions to limit the current unbalance are listed in the last part of this paper.

articleTitle: Performance test and evaluation of photovoltaic system
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: In this paper, the performance ratio (PR) of PV system is evaluated by field testing. The sampling strategy of efficiency chain for PV system is determined by analyzing long-term operation monitoring data of PV system. The efficiency parameters of components are extracted. The efficiency model of components in PV system is established in PVsyst software. Combining efficiency models, geographic information and the long time weather information, the PR of PV system and the yield over the next twenty-five years can be evaluated.

articleTitle: Full-capacity wind turbine with inertial support by optimizing phase-locked loop
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel inertial control method based on optimizing the dynamic response of phase-locked loop (PLL) of full-capacity wind turbine (FCWT). Different from the typical inertial control strategy with PD controller, the proposed method utilizes the phase-tracking error provided by the optimized PLL to modify the rotor speed references without detecting the grid frequency or calculating the frequency derivative. In order to realize the expected inertial response characteristic, control parameters of PLL should be optimized, and the phase-locked loop error (Δθ) should be introduced to the speed reference. The controller design follows the principle that the WT can fast response and participate in stabilizing the grid frequency based on the large amount of rotational kinetic energy stored in the rotor when frequency fluctuates in grid. With this control strategy, the kinetic energy is released and transformed to the grid directly to improve frequency stability of power grid. Simulation model was built in MATLAB/Simulink and simulated results demonstrate the feasibility and correctness of the presented control method.

articleTitle: Research on new monitoring system for important power users in smart distribution network
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: Recently, the monitoring service for important users in the distribution network is relatively insufficient in China, which greatly influences the efficiency of power distribution. Based on the embedded MCU, wireless sensor network and Ethernet communication technology, a kind of intelligent monitoring system for distribution network is presented according to the characteristics of important power users. The collected data could be shared with the electric power company through Ethernet, which realizes the automation and remote power information monitoring. The monitoring system consists of data acquisition terminals, network concentrator and remote server. The power information and the status data of key devices could be collected by the data acquisition terminals, which consists of precision sensors and a signal conditioning circuit. The data are sent to a network concentrator through 433MHz wireless networks. The network concentrator communicates with the remote server and exchanges data with the data acquisition terminals simultaneously. The remote server is able to display, process and store the real-time information, including grid basic energy data, major power quality parameters and equipment operating status.

articleTitle: Prediction of wind turbine gearbox gears fatigue damage under turbulent loading based on spectrum method
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: This paper presents research result of short term wind turbulence impacts to gearbox dynamic response of wind turbines. Fatigue assessment method for non-zero nonGaussian process is developed. A fluid dynamic model is built for wind speed and dynamic response model for wind turbine gearbox is constructed. Impacts of non-Gaussian loading to gear fatigue damage assessment of gearbox stress spectral density are analyzed. Wind speed, which serve as external excitation to wind turbines fatigue damage are studied. A new method of frequency-domain fatigue assessment method is developed for non-zero non Gaussian process. SCADA data is also proposed as a new testing source to prove the fatigue assessment method. The research is meaningful to improve wind turbine reliability and contribute to development of wind turbine gearbox fatigue assessment theory. The result provides useful theory and tools for future prognostic maintenance.

articleTitle: Study on the accommodation capability of renewable power in local power grid based on production simulation and its solution
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: With the rapid development of wind power and photovoltaic energy, renewable energy installation in three-north has exceeded 20%, in some areas, renewable energy installation has become the second largest power source exceeding hydro-power. Renewable energy power curtailment has become normal state, it is on urgent need to carry out accommodated capacity analysis, and put forward corresponding measures on this basis, so as to maintain the sustainable development of renewable energy. This paper carries out study on accommodation capacity of renewable energy in local power grid based on production simulation and its improving measures. Based on the analysis of problems and challenges faced by accommodation of local power grid, by reference to latest research developments on renewable energy accommodation overseas, objective function and boundary conditions are set up, accommodation analysis model is established based on production simulation, take renewable energy accommodation capacity in three-north as a research example, conduct sensitivity analysis combining influence factor, aim at stimulating the flexibility of the system, analyze and access the feasibility and the result of the measured put forward, and finally put forward comprehensive solution to renewable energy accommodation capacity of the system.

articleTitle: Zero DC voltage ride through of a hybrid Modular Multilevel Converter — Part II: Analysis and suppression of electromagnetic transients
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: DC short circuit fault is a serious problem modular multilevel converter (MMC)-HVDC has to deal with, in particular for the applications using overhead transmission lines typically in China. This two series papers present a zero DC voltage ride through method during bipolar DC short circuit fault for HVDC system based on hybrid modular multilevel converter, which is composed of half-bridge sub-modules (HBSMs) and full-bridge sub-modules (FBSMs). As the first part, this paper illustrates the principle and control implementation using the negative level output capability of FBSMs to rapidly reduce the converter's output DC voltage and speed up the fault current attenuation. Moreover, it is found out that there are plenty of coordinated schemes between FBSMs and HBSMs during DC fault ride through period, which are dependent on the distributed relationships of fundamental components in converter arm's output voltage between FBSMs and HBSMs. As a result, in order to describe this relationship, a variable, viz., voltage distributing factor, is defined. Finally, comparison studies among the proposed zero DC voltage ride through method of hybrid MMC with different voltage distributing factors, and the conventional fault blocking method of FBSM-based MMC were conducted by simulations in PSCAD.

articleTitle: LVRT control strategy for photovoltaic inverter based on current derating
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: According to grid connected standard for photovoltaic power generation system, a LVRT control strategy for photovoltaic inverter based on active current derating is proposed. First, under grid normal condition a control strategy based on antiwindup PI controller is proposed, which reduces the influence of integral saturation on current reference value; Then, a LVRT control strategy based on current reference value derating in order to reduce DC bus voltage fluctuation and smooth grid-connected current change. Finally, LVRT experiment test results on a 500kVA photovoltaic inverter shows that the LVRT control strategy can apply various grid voltage dips and achieve good dynamic, static performance, the control parameters is universal with the control strategy under grid normal condition , and the switching logic of these two control strategy under grid normal and fault condition is simple.

articleTitle: Model study of photovoltaic inverter for bulk power system studies based on comprehensive tests
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: With ever increasing large-scale grid-connected photovoltaic (PV) power plants, there is an urgent need for accurate PV plant model to study the impact of PV generation integration. In this paper, the PV inverter model for bulk power system studies is investigated based on comprehensive tests. At first, the inverter model is introduced. The model consists of local controller module, fault ride through and protective controller module, and grid interface module. Then a real 500kW inverter is adopted for two series of test. These tests include voltage disturbance test and control command disturbance test to identify parameters of different modules respectively. Finally, the model is simulated on DIgSILENT PowerFactory software package and validated with test data. The model validation results show a good match between simulation and measurement data.

articleTitle: A hybrid algorithm for reactive power optimization based on bi-level programming
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: This paper established a bi-level programming model for reactive power optimization, considering the feature of the grid voltage-reactive power control. The targets of upper-level and lower-level are minimization of grid loss and voltage deviation, respectively. According to the differences of two level, such as different variables, different solution space, primal-dual interior point algorithm is suggested to be used in upper-level, which takes continuous variables in account such as active power source and reactive power source. Upper-level model guaranteed the sufficient of the reactive power in power system. And then in lower-level the discrete variables such as taps are optimized by random forests algorithm (RFA), which regulate the voltage in a feasible range. Finally, a case study illustrated the speediness and robustness of this method.

articleTitle: Stator current transient performance of induction motor under different voltage sag conditions
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: Voltage sag is the common power-quality disturbance and influence the operation performance of motors. The voltage sag consists of two transient processes including the beginning and the end of voltage sag that can cause the inrush current. This paper provided a new method which can also be used in wind turbine control named space vector transform method to calculate the inrush current and then made experiments to verify the results by using a 5.5kW motor. In the end, the influence of voltage sag characteristics including amplitude, duration, initial phase angle and phase-angle jump on stator current of the induction motor with no load are systematically studied and experimental validation is also performed. The results show that peak currents of drop voltage point and recovery voltage point depend linearly on the voltage drop but the onset peak current has a periodic dependence on the sag duration, furthermore, three phase peak currents have a periodical relationship with initial phase and the period is 60°.

articleTitle: Simulation analysis on the feasibility of a high temperature superconducting magnetic energy storage system applied in a wind farm
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: A voltage source converter (VSC) based high temperature superconducting (HTS) magnetic energy storage system (SMES) has been optimal designed and constructed by China Electric Power Research Institute (CEPRI). This SMES uses two kinds of high temperature superconductors, YBCO and BSCCO tapes for the first time. The application planning of SMES with the equivalent capacity in a practical renewable power system at Zhangbei wind power test base in China is evaluated by a simulation analysis based on the PSCAD/EMTDC. An optimal switch time of the SMES in Zhangbei wind farm is presented using the real transmission parameters of Zhangbei power grid. This study can provide a demonstration of large-scale SMES systems in a renewable power system.

Author Keywords: high temperature superconducting magnetic energy storage (HT SMES) system

articleTitle: Smart substation secondary system visualization and intelligent diagnosis based on improved SCD model
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: Substation configuration description (SCD) plays a significant role in IEC 61850 smart substations. This paper analyses present situations of SCD application and proposes an effective solution of secondary system visualization and intelligent diagnosis for smart substations using an approved SCD model. It is possible to realize various advanced applications and object-oriented management of smart substation based on the complete SCD model, which will provide reliable technical support for substation operation without human being, dispatching and control integrated, as well as operation and maintenance integrated. The proposed scheme based on the extended SCD model has been validated in a 500kV smart substation test-bed.

articleTitle: Research on state vulnerability of power grid with large scale new energy sources based on short circuit capacity margin
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: Vulnerability of a power grid indicates its capability to resist cascading failures, and state vulnerability, which is an important part of vulnerability, of grid becomes a research hotspot in recent years. With the development of smart grid,large scale wind farms and photovoltaic plants are integrated into power grid, whose ability to provide short circuit capacity is weaker than synchronous machines, and are treated as PQ nodes in grid. This characteristic is more likely to cause or extend cascading failure. Therefore, research on state vulnerability of this kind of power supply nodes is worthy of careful study. In this paper, calculation method of short circuit capacity provided by large scale wind farms and photovoltaic plants is developed, and further, the concept of short-circuit capacity margin, which compares actual short circuit capacity demanded by the network with short circuit capacity provided by power supply nodes, is proposed to evaluate state vulnerability of power grid. It reveals the influence on the ability of power supply nodes to resist the cascading disturbances / failures of power grid in essence, meanwhile,it is also able to quantitative assessment abilities of different types of power supplies to support grid in the same output and then provide some guidance to adjust the balance of the short-circuit capacity margin of the power supply node by adjusting the grid operation mode or power control mode. The proposed method can be applied to offline or online state vulnerability assessment, to provide decision support for power system planning and dispatching. Finally, a case study based on IEEE39 node system proves the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Reliability evaluation based on Monte Carlo simulation considering islanded operation in distribution network with micogrid
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: Based on equivalent simplification of distribution network, an effective method was described to identify the faults' effect on load points' reliability accounting for islanded operation in this paper. According to the characteristics of distributed generators (DGs) and annual average load curve, the corresponding probability models can be formulated. On this basis, an improved sequential Monte Carlo simulation method was proposed to make the reliability evaluation of distribution network considering intentional islanding. The proposed method has been tested on feeder F4 of IEEE-RBTS Bus 6. The results show that the proposed method has better efficiency in reliability evaluation of distribution network.

articleTitle: Reliability assessment for active distribution network considering demand side management
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: Considering the randomness and intermittence of the distributed energy resources (DERs) in the active distribution network (ADN), chronological model is superimposed on stochastic model and the models of distributed generation, energy storage system and controllable load are established in this paper. The interrupted load is classified in accordance with the cause of fault, and the objective function of load shedding comprehensively considers load priority, lack power and outage frequency, then the improved genetic algorithm (GA) is taken for the optimal load-shedding scheme. Reliability assessment algorithm of ADN based on pseudo sequential Monte Carlo (PSMC) is presented, then the average load shifting rate is defined and its sensitivity analysis is conducted. The case results show that the integration of DER can improve system reliability indices effectively and loads implementing of demand side management (DSM) can not only enhance the reliability indices of the load itself, but also the remaining loads in the system.

articleTitle: Effect of site conditions on offshore wind turbine failures
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: Failure of offshore wind turbine components is one of the main contributors to the O&M cost and in turn the cost of energy from offshore wind. In order to try and reduce the O&M costs a clear understanding of what drives these failures must be obtained. This paper aims to find a correlation between weather conditions and turbine failures. Site conditions examined include, amongst others, wind speed, turbulence intensity and turbine positioning in the wind farm. A modern population of offshore turbines is analysed in this work. Exact turbine and wind farm numbers, rated power and blade size cannot be provided for confidentiality reasons. The findings of this analysis show that, weather conditions are a key factor to offshore turbine failures.

articleTitle: An improved hybrid hill climb searching control for MPPT of wind power generation systems under fast varying wind speed
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: Wind speed sensorless control methods for wind turbine maximum power point tracking are beneficial as they do not require knowledge of wind speed or wind turbine characteristics. In this paper, an advanced hybrid hill climb searching (HCS) algorithm is proposed via combining the conventional HCS and power signal feedback (PSF) control with a novel algorithm to judge the wind speed variation direction. During the period that the wind speed is judged constant, the controller optimizes the parameter of the power curve. The proposed method is verified in simulation on a permanent magnetic synchronous generator (PMSG) based wind turbine. Simulation results show that this algorithm has better performance in tracking the maximum power coefficient than the conventional algorithms, particularly in variable wind speed.

articleTitle: The influence of wind farm group topology structure on power flow distribution
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: The wind energy resources are rich and concentrated in China, and many wind farms often distribute in one windy area. These wind power should be gathered through the appropriate topology so that they could be sent to the electricity grid. This paper mainly compares several common different wind power collection systems. And on this basis, we use the PSD - BPA power system analysis software to analyse a wind power group with 12 wind farms, mainly focusing on the difference of the distribution of the power flow under different topologies. Besides, we will also compare the difference of the output with the wind speed change and other situations under different topologies.

articleTitle: A novel flexible load coordination control based on distributed generation consumption in the active distribution network
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: With the reform of electrical market, the application of demand-side management or demand response has been widely researched. The large elasticity of electricity price enables a more flexible control strategy in load-side. In this paper, the basic features of flexible loads including continuous and discrete loads or interruptible or notinterruptible loads will be analysed and modelled. Besides, all constrains concerning the behaviour of power consumption have been brought up. Next, an optimal control strategy oriented to minimum the energy expenditure of a typical home would be established and elaborated. Finally, a study case would be applied to validate the efficiency of the theory. The newly proposed method will be in the end validated by the on-site project of the National High-tech R&D Program (863 Program) in Guizhou Province, China.

articleTitle: Analysis and evaluation of the decoupling control strategies for the design of grid-connected inverter with LCL filter
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: Proportion-integration (PI) controllers in rotating frame have been considered to design the current controllers for the grid-connected VSI with LCL filter. One issue that must be considered is how to eliminate the complicated coupling terms between d-axis and q-axis in the mathematical model in synchronous reference frame. The direct decoupling modeling process eliminates the interaction between d-axis and q-axis by neglecting the coupling terms, directly, such as small external disturbances. The feedforward compensation decoupling modeling process realizes precise modeling by feeding forward compensation for the relevant coupling terms gradually to improve the quality of the grid-connected current. By designing the Simulink models based on dual closed current loop control strategy, these two decoupling methods are verified. At last, a concept of feedforward compensation coefficient, which provides a new selection criterion for the design of decoupling control strategy of the grid-connected inverter with LCL filter, is proposed after comparing the advantage and disadvantage of two decoupling control strategies in eliminating the interaction between output active power and reactive power and improving the quality of grid-connected current.

articleTitle: A control strategy for hybrid energy storage system based on state of charge and variable filter coefficient
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: A hybrid energy storage system (HESS), which combines the advantages of different energy storage systems, can reduce the fluctuations of renewable energy output power effectively. In this study, we adopt the low-pass filtering algorithm, whose filter coefficient is mixed with the state of charge (SOC) of the HESS in order to dynamically adjust the goal output, and make the power fluctuations stable within the prescribed range. According to the SOCs of two energy storage mediums, the fuzzy control theory is adopted to distribute the power deviation reasonably. When the supercapacitors' energy is adequate, supercapacitors compensate the power deviation independently to reduce the number of times of battery charging and discharging. Numerical results show that this control strategy can effectively level the fluctuations of renewable energy power, avoid the out-of-limit phenomenon of energy storage mediums, and extend the service life of the battery.

articleTitle: Probabilistic optimal power flow of distirbution system with distribution generation considering corelation relationship
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: Aiming at the optimal power flow problem (OPF) of distribution network, this paper firstly establishes a multiobjective OPF model including the lowest cost of power generation, the minimum pollutant treatment cost and the minimum active power loss. Theconstraints include active power and reactive power flow equation constraints and inequality constraints including the limits of active power output of generations, the upper and lower limits of node voltage, and the penetration limits of distribution generations. Then use the fuzzy set theory to reformulate the multiobjective OPF problem into a single objective nonlinear programming problem. According to the probabilistic OPF of distribution network with random output of related distribution generation (DG) units, this paper adopts Cholesky factorization to handle the correlations between DG units and point estimation method to transform the probabilistic OPF problem a deterministic calculation using the above OPF method. Based on the estimated samples obtained by point estimation method, the statistical characteristics of multiobjective OPF can be obtained. The modified IEEE 33-node system is used to verify the proposed method.

articleTitle: Coordinated control of distributed energy resources and flexible links in active distribution networks
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: Active distribution networks (DNs) have to integrate a high level of distributed energy resources (DER). Using the classical control strategies, such amount of DER results in overvoltages and lines saturations across the system. To overcome these problems, a new control approach in the DMS is presented in this paper. This approach consists on using the DER reactive power capability and coordinate them with flexible links which can virtually mesh the naturally radial DN. The proposed control relies on an optimization problem which decreases the system losses and improves the voltage profile.

articleTitle: Optimal controller gains for inner current controllers in VSC inverters
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: The standard method for controlling an IGBT inverter (or any VSC inverter for that matter) is by vector current control. This control system consists of two cascaded control loops. One possible realisation of the outer controller is to control the DC bus voltage such that no more power is taken off the DC bus than is available. This creates a current reference, which is fed into the inner current controller. The inner current controller then regulates the current passing through the IGBT such that the desired power is dispatched onto the grid. Whilst most research treats the grid connection as a simple RL circuit, there is little consistency on the method by which the gains of the inner current controller are selected. Internal model control, modulus optimum and root locus methods are just a few of the methods used to find the gains. However, it is not clear which of these methods yields the best performance of the inner current controller. This work suggests that tuning on phase margin or manually tuning may not achieve the best results.

articleTitle: Whole machine modelling and dynamic characteristic analysis of 1.5MW wind turbine
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: A rigid-flexible coupled virtual prototype of a 1.5MW wind turbine generator system was established in this paper to analysis the dynamic characteristic of the wind turbine. First of all, using Pro/E and Nastran to build the model of wind turbine, and then transfer it into ADAMS to calculate the natural frequency of the total wind turbine. The first 5-order natural frequency and mode shapes are extracted in the paper to show the analyzing effect. The Campbell diagram is used to verify whether the operating frequency of the wind turbine has avoided the natural frequency of the calculation model.

articleTitle: Wind farm simulation modelling and control for primary frequency support
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: A Matlab/Simulink based tool for developing fast simulation wind farm models has been proposed. The wind farm development tool accepts user defined parameters such as mean wind speed, turbulent intensity wind farm layout and etc. to develop a wind farm model. The wind farm model contains the 5MW Supergen wind turbine dynamics suitable for controller design, a wind-field model based on the Veers algorithm for generating turbulent wind-field, and wake models based on the Frandsen analytical wake modelling technique for representing the wake propagation through the wind farm. The developed wind farm model is suitable for active power control and developing control algorithms for primary frequency response.

articleTitle: Low carbon unit commitment for power system with wind farms and carbon capture devices based on DE-BBO algorithm
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: With constant improvement of the individual environmental awareness, people have woken up to the truth that the key solution to climate change lies in the reduction of CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> in the air. Both access of large-scale wind power and proposition of carbon capture technology, along with low-carbon dispatching for power system have increased uncertainty of power grid operation and exerted an influence on generating costs of the system. Under such circumstances, it is an urgent task to figure out the reasonable generation scheduling and realize the energy conservation and emission reduction, in line with our aspiration level. In the present paper, based on the adoption of a combined dispatching for electricity generation and carbon emission, we proposed a optimized dispatch model which took the carbon capture device and wind power plant into consideration, under the current requirement of energy conservation and emission reduction. The binary DE-BBO algorithm and the minimum marginal cost method have been proposed to solve the proposed dispatch model. Numerical results of the IEEE-RTS 24-bus system show that the proposed model can achieve to enable low-carbon dispatching and meanwhile realize the optimal acceptance of wind power, with remarkable energy saving efficiency.

articleTitle: Comparative study on reliability of wind farm collector systems
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: In this paper, the reliability of wind farm collector systems with different topologies including radiation network, star network and the hybrid of radiation and star network is compared with each other based on the quantitative calculation. Since the wind turbine generators belong to power generation source and the wind farm collector system is nearly the same as distribution system, so this paper combines the equal energy not served principal in reliability evaluation of generation system with the reliability evaluation approaches of distribution network to assess the reliability of wind farm collector system. Specifically, the complicated structures are decomposed into simple portions by networkequivalent method, and then calculate the equivalent outage rate of each portion by the minimal path method. And the reliability indices referrers to both generation system and distribution system, such as the outage time, loss of generation probability e.g. are selected. Last,taking three wind farms with the same wind turbine generator installation but different collector systems as an example, the comparative study on reliability of the above different topologies is implemented in detail. The results show that the wind farm with star configuration has the optimal indexes and is the most reliable one among the above three topologies.

articleTitle: Comparison of harmonic propagation methods considering uncertainties of harmonic injection
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: Probabilistic harmonic power flow (PHPF) is the basis of evaluating the impact of new energy integration to the grid. A PHPF scheme based on 2m+1 point estimate method (2m+1 PEM) was proposed in this paper on account that the uncertainties of injected harmonic current amplitudes and phases caused by intermittent and volatile new energy power generation device connected to the electricity grid. This method avoids the establishment analytic form relationship between input random variables and output random variables. According to the high order moment of sample data to makeup estimation point, the expectation, variance and other statistical information of branches could be calculated. Actual example is adopted to validate the method described in this article and result show that the accuracy of this method is similar to the ratio of the Monte Carlo simulation method in the case of less calculated amounts. As a comparison of interval analysis method (IAM), the results are more scientific and reasonable. Moreover, considering double uncertainties including amplitude and phase of harmonic injection source matches the practice better.

articleTitle: A novel DC power flow controller for VSC-MTDC system
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel dc power flow controller for multi-terminal HVDC (MTDC) system, which can be inserted in series on transmission lines to manage dc power flow of them. Its key features include: 1) simpler circuit topology, 2) fewer components and 3) elimination of external power supply and low-frequency high-voltage-insulation isolated transformer. A three-terminal HVDC system including the dc power flow controller is studied and its operation principle and characteristics are analyzed. A simulation mode is built to test the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed dc power flow controller with cases of power injection step down, power loss of one terminal. The results show that the proposed dc power flow controller can enhance the performance and controllability of a MTDC system.

articleTitle: A sliding mode control based maximum power point tracking method of PV arrays under partially shaded conditions
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: Aiming at the multi peak phenomenon in the output power characteristic curve of photovoltaic (PV) array under partially-shaded conditions, this paper addresses a new global maximum power point tracking (GMPPT) method based on sliding mode control (SMC). First, the output power characteristic curve of the PV array is scanned and the global maximum power point (GMPP) is stored at the same times. The SMC is introduced in this process, which greatly reduces the scanning time. Then the SMC based MPPT (SMC-MPPT) method is adopted to quickly stabilize the the operating point of the PV array at the GMPP, reducing the power fluctuations during steady-state operation. Simulation results validate that the proposed method can track the GMPP with good dynamic response performance under partially shaded conditions, reducing the power loss of the whole tracking process.

articleTitle: Research on analysis method for photovoltaic power considering weather type
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: With the increasing of PV power integration, the uncertainty of PV power affects the security of the grid seriously. It is necessary to master random characteristics of Photovoltaic(PV) power for power system planning and operation. An analysis method of random characteristics of PV power considering weather type is proposed. The clear sky model of PV is built and the actual PV power output can be divided into the product of the clear sky output and relative output, which is decomposed into the benchmark output and fluctuation output caused by different clouds and weather conditions, a complete PV output model description is formed. Then, the curves are divided into four categories based on the weather fluctuation characteristics, corresponding to the sunny, cloudy, overcast and variation weather. Furthermore, the distribution characteristics of benchmark output and fluctuation output are also analyzed in this paper.

articleTitle: Static reactive power compensation margin analysis of an actual wind farm
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: With more and more wind farms connected to the power grid, the problem of wind farm reactive power compensation margin is becoming more and more important. In this paper, the reactive power compensation margin of an actual wind farm under static operation situation is analysed. Firstly, the source of reactive power loss in the wind farm is analysed theoretically. And then, the reactive power compensation margins of the wind farm, under the condition of N-1 and N-2 of reactive power compensation device are analysed respectively. Finally, the reactive power compensation margin of the wind farm under the voltage and transformation tap in the range of allowed changes with the N-1, N-2 of reactive power compensation device is presented.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis of wind turbine gearbox based on kernel fuzzy c-means clustering
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: Conventional methods for fault diagnosis need a process of supervised training based on historical samples of known fault. However, it is time-consuming and costly to collect all kinds of known fault samples. In practice, it is lack of complete known samples for supervised training. These methods fail to diagnose a new or unknown fault. In this paper, a method based on kernel fuzzy c-means clustering (KFCM) was proposed to diagnose the known and unknown faults for fault diagnosis of wind turbine gearbox. At first, the samples of known samples were classified by KFCM and the class centre of each known fault was acquired. Similarity parameters in kernel space between new data samples and known class centres were employed in this paper. Thereafter similarity parameters were calculated for diagnosing whether the new data samples belong to knows faults. The proposed method was applied in fault diagnosis of wind turbine gearbox. The results show that the proposed method can diagnose both the known faults and unknown faults accurately and effectively.

articleTitle: Error comparsion and analysis of three interpolation methods for data synchronization of electronic transformer
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: In power system, the data synchronization of electronic transformer is the precondition and guarantee for protection's correct operation. In this paper, the origin of electronic transformer data asynchronization is introduced first, and the common interpolation methods to solve the problem are given. Considering the most general form of the sampled signal, the interpolation error expressions of linear, quadratic and cubic spline interpolation methods are deduced and the influencing factors are discussed. Besides, the changing relationships between interpolation errors of the three methods and the influencing factors are calculated by simulation, and the interpolation accuracy of the three methods are compared and analyzed. The research results provide theoretical references for selection of interpolation methods to achieve electronic transformer data synchronization.

articleTitle: An output current based seamless transfer control strategy for three-phase converter with energy storage in micro-grid
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: Micro-grid should go into intentional islanding operation to supply power for the local critical loads in the utility outage condition. Three-phase converter with energy storage in micro-grid is used to transfer between the islanding mode and the grid-tied mode seamlessly. This paper proposes a transfer strategy based on output current of the three-phase converter with energy storage in the micro-grid, which composes of an external inductor current loop, a grid voltage loop and an inner inductor current loop. The converter is regulated as a current source just by the inner inductor current loop in the grid-tied operation. Once islanding happens, a serious transient error may be generated between the output current and the reference current. The voltage loop is fixed by the limiter, then, the converter operates as a voltage source. The quality of load voltage can be guaranteed and the continuous power supply is realized. Additionally, the parameters design of the control strategy is analyzed, and the operation principle is proposed in detail. Finally, the control strategy is verified by the simulation result.

articleTitle: Research on electric vehicle cluster model based on scenes simulation
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: In recent years, the development of electric vehicles (EVs) has received more attention. As a mobile energy storage unit, electric vehicle can realize energy exchange with the power grid. However, the character of random charging and discharging makes it difficult for the integration of EVs. Conventional charging, fast charging and battery replacement are the most commonly used charging modes for EVs. First, a charging model is proposed considering a variety of scenes of the random charging of EVs in this paper. The method of random sampling is used to establish a statistical model of timing distribution of EVs load. The proposed model can well reflect the charging cluster characteristics of a large scale of EVs connected to gird widely and randomly. Then, considering the discharging characteristics of EVs in the specified time period, a charging and discharging cluster model is established based on the method of Latin hypercube sampling. The agglomeration model can reflect the timing distribution characteristics of EVs in a 24-hour cycle. Finally, the model verifies the effect of peak load shifting of EVs.

articleTitle: Monthly unit commitment with the consideration of wind farms correlation
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: With large scale wind integration into power grid, the monthly unit commitment scheduling and the consumption of wind have great challenges due to the randomness and correlation of wind power. In view of the randomness of wind power, reserve and security constraints are addressed in the probability form, further the chance-constrained model of monthly unit commitment is derived. Then, the correlation between the wind farms is considered, and the combined probability distribution of various wind farms is described and established by dependent probabilistic sequence operation theory. Accordingly, the chance-constrained stochastic formulation is converted into a deterministic programming problem, which can avoid the tedious process of simulation, and a mixed integer linear programming method is utilized to solve the monthly scheduling problem. Numerical cases are performed with a modified IEEE 118-bus system. The results show the viability of the proposed formulation.

articleTitle: The study and application of power flow controller for DC grids
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: With the development of modern power grid, traditional DC grid has evolved from multi-terminal HVDC (MTDC) to meshed DC grid. It can be realized through the control of converter station's output voltage when one of the branches is over limit and need to be adjusted or must regulate the power flow to follow some dispatch orders. However, in the meshed DC grid, this adjustment will also significantly change the power flow of the other branches. This paper presents a new approach that series a converter into the branch which is under control. By changing the DC side voltage of the converter to regulate the voltage difference between the two ends of the branch, only the specific branch's power flow will be changed remarkably, and there will just have a little change in the other branches. In this paper, several DC power flow control devices which had been proposed were analyzed through works and operating characteristics, and then the feasibility of the series voltage source was verified through the simulation.

articleTitle: Multi-objective optimization design for active damping LCL grid-connected filter
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: LCL filters, as the interface between the grid-connected inverters and the grid, overcome some of drawbacks of L or LC filters, especially have great performance used in medium and high power range situation. Methods of introducing passive damping and active damping are used to solving the stability problem around the resonance frequency. This paper purposed an active damping method based on introducing capacitor current feedback which can effectively control current resonance without changing the resonance frequency of LCL filter and avoid increasing wastage and reducing system efficiency. On the basis of above research, synthetically considering current attenuation ratio, transfer function amplitude and cost of the filter, the multi-objective optimization model of active damping LCL filter and optimization algorithm based on NSGA-Ċ are presented. Effectiveness of the optimization method is verified by simulations on PSCAD.

articleTitle: Dynamic decision model of critical peak pricing considering electric vehicles' charging load
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: The continuous increase of peak load in China has made significant impact on the safety and stability of power grid. Meanwhile, electric vehicles are developing rapidly in China and whether their charging load can be controlled effectively by reasonable guidance without worsening the peak load problem becomes a challenge for the power system. Traditional solutions to balance electricity demand and supply, such as adding generators and using power orderly, are less economically efficient than DR programs. Critical peak pricing (CPP), which is a type of price-based DR program, can encourage customers to reduce or shift load during critical peak hours and alleviate the pressure of power supply. In this paper, a CPP dynamic decision-making model is proposed in which a trigger condition is set to determine critical days and hours and the particle swarm optimization algorithm is adopted to optimize the peak rate and the rebate. Additionally, the influence of electric vehicles' charging load is considered in the proposed model. Finally, the numerical results show that the proposed CPP is apparently effective at reducing peak load and with the increase of the number of electric vehicles, the optimized peak electricity price gradually reduces to reach a stable level.

articleTitle: Model-predictive direct power control of grid-connected inverters for PV systems
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: Based on the instantaneous power theory, photovoltaic grid connected inverter power predictive model in d-q rotating coordinates was established. After sampling grid current, output active power and reactive power of the grid-connected can be directly predicted by using the predictive model. The model predictive direct power control strategy of photovoltaic grid connected inverter was designed. According to the power predictive model and cost function, the optimal space voltage vector was selected. The proposed control strategy does not need PWM modulation module and the inner current control. It has low computational complexity and easy to be implemented. The control system performance was simulated in different light intensity conditions. The results show that the grid-connected inverter can track illumination change and output power with good dynamic and static performance, which validate the effectiveness of proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Impact of atmospheric stability on wind turbine wake velocity distribution
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: With the up-scaling of wind farms, wake effect has become a major factor which restricts wind power generation. Accurate simulation of the wind turbine wake velocity decay is of great significance to improve the current situation. Against the limitation of the neutral atmospheric hypothesis in wake simulation, the impact of atmospheric stability is taken into consideration in this paper. Establish the geometric models of single wind turbine, use different Monin-Obuhkov length values to represent diverse atmospheric stability classifications, carry on flow numerical simulation with RANS method. And then obtain wind speed distributions under stable, neural and unstable atmospheric stabilities. Extract the wind speed on hub height behind rotor, and do research on the wake velocity recovery conditions under various atmosphere status. Results show that wake velocity curves under different M-O length take on a variety of distribution characters. The average wind speed in wake area from high to low in order is unstable, neutral and stable atmosphere status. The more stable the atmosphere status, the slower the wake recovery rate. But for any selected atmosphere status, the wake speed in 30 times diameter length behind rotor can all recover to 90% of the inflow wind.

articleTitle: Grounding impedance characteristcs of gravity foundations of offshore wind turbines
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: Wind power is considered as a potential energy to solve the power shortage. The wind farm and wind power generation develop quickly these years. Due to the influence of the tides which determined sea level, the grounding impedance of wind turbines will be in a greater fluctuation and even reach a dangerous figure. So it is necessary to research on the grounding impedance of offshore wind turbines especially in intertidal zone. In this paper, steel gravity foundations of offshore wind turbines were selected as calculation models using CDEGS software. Various affecting factors were considered, including depth of seawater caused by tide, soil resistivity, thickness of claypan and gravel according to the characteristics of area of wind farm. Different size, material, and installation method of gravity foundations are also considered and calculated. Simulation results show that grounding impedance is influenced most severely by depth of seawater. On the basis of calculation, the limit values of grounding impedance in some kinds of area that wind farms locate in are given. The following shows relations between grounding impedance and depth of sea water in different soil resistivity area for example.

articleTitle: Offshore cost of energy for DFIG PRC turbines vs. PMG FRC turbines
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: In order to bring the Cost of Energy (CoE) from offshore wind in line with traditional energy generation forms, turbine types that produce the lowest CoE must be chosen. Modern wind turbines vary greatly in their drive train configurations. With the variety of options available it can be difficult to determine which type is most suitable for offshore applications. A large percentage of modern drive trains consist of either doubly fed induction generators with partially rated converters or permanent magnet generators with fully rated converters. These configurations were the focus of this empirical CoE comparison. The turbine populations from which CoE inputs were drawn for this comparison contained ~2,600 turbines. The findings from this comparison show that, for a hypothetical 100 turbine site 40km offshore, the PMG FRC turbine has a CoE that is £2.31/MWh lower than that of a DFIG PRC turbine.

articleTitle: Transmission loss minimization based on hierarchical control in multi-terminal DC grids
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: This paper proposes an efficient power flow sharing and voltage regulation control method based on hierarchical control to minimize the transmission loss of multi-terminal DC grids. Both power electronic converter loss and line loss are taken into consideration. Different from conventional optimal power flow (OPF) algorithm for DC grid, the proposed approach needs neither prior knowledge of grid structure and parameters nor measurement of power flow in each branch. Simulation result shows the proposed method reduces the transmission loss of MTDC by 10%~50% compare with conventional hierarchical voltage regulation control.

articleTitle: A schedule method of battery energy storage system (BESS) to track day-ahead photovoltaic output power schedule based on short-term photovoltaic power prediction
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: In order to maximize the ability to improve the photovoltaic (PV) system tracking schedule output, based on the short-term prediction power of PV and randomness of prediction error, an energy storage day-ahead scheduling policy that adopts chance-constrained programming is proposed. The PV/energy storage output within the upper and lower range of schedule plan is taken as the objective function, the energy storage charge and discharge power and the state of charge (SOC) constraints are considered. In order to get each time charge and discharge power, the method adopts improved adaptive particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm based on Monte Carlo simulation. With typical output of PV power station as an example, the simulation results verify the feasibility and flexibility of the proposed strategy, it also provides effective reference scheme for day-ahead control of battery energy storage systems.

articleTitle: Analyze of low voltage ride-through on-site test platform and test method in medium and large PV power station
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: With the rapid increasing of solar power installed capacity, the utility has higher requirement to the Low voltage ride-through (LVRT) capability of grid-connected PV power station. The PV power station is expected to continue operation during the fault, especially the voltage drop of the grid. Therefore, the effective on-site test platform has been desired and needed thereby matching latest standards not only in China but also in the worldwide. In this paper, based on latest standards, one suitable and convenience on-site test platform and one on-site testing technique for Medium and large PV power plant is proposed and introduced. Meanwhile, the corresponding simulation result is verified the effectiveness and practicality.

Author Keywords: Medium and large PV power station

articleTitle: Photovoltaic forecasting through establishing solar models without using diffuse radiation measurement in Beijing
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: Solar diffuse radiation data is one of the most important parameters for assessing solar energy resource and designing grid connected photovoltaic system, due to the characteristics of ground solar radiation change significantly in recent years, previous solar beam-diffuse radiation separated model has been unable to true reflect the variation of solar radiation. A method for estimating diffuse radiation fraction Hd/H is proposed. Take Beijing as an example, according to the local measured radiation data during 10 years, with localized revising of Erbs, a new model is built. Then the relative number of sunshine hours S/S0 is introduced to establish the new regression equation with better fitting effect. Furthermore, the accuracy of model is validated using measured data consists of solar radiation and sunshine hours of 2011. Comparison of four models is performed through error analysis. It is found that the model including two variable is of high prediction accuracy. In most months, the error is lower than 10% The new model more in line with the radiation characteristics of the local actual, for photovoltaic system design has the reference significance.

articleTitle: Voltage and reactive power control of a wind farm based on nine zone diagram
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: With the rapid development of wind power in China, the impact of large-scale wind farms on the power grid becomes increasingly serious. Among which, the voltage fluctuation at the PCC (point of common coupling), has attracted a lot of attention. In this paper, the effects of voltage and reactive power control on wind farms are analysed based on the nine zone diagram method. Firstly, the modified nine zone diagram for the wind farm substation is presented. And then, the characteristics of voltage and reactive power control are discussed from the viewpoint of modified nine zone diagram. Furthermore, the control strategy of voltage and reactive power is designed based on the modified nine zone diagram. Finally, simulations of an actual wind farm are done on to verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Rotor dynamics of DFIG wind turbines under grid faults
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: With the increasing wind power penetration, the electromechanical transient stability of wind turbines is more and more significant. Deep research of rotor dynamics of wind turbines is fundamental to the stability analysis during grid faults. This paper concentrates on the rotor motion of doubly-fed induction generator (DFIG) wind turbines (WTs) during a symmetrical grid fault. Various factors having influence on input or/and output powers are considered under the existing transient power control strategy. The objective of this paper is to provide an insight into the rotor dynamic behaviour of DFIG WTs during grid faults.

articleTitle: Deployment and control strategy of reactive power devices in large wind power collection stations
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: Due to the features of wind sources location and power grid structure, the development mode of wind power in China presents characteristics of building large wind power bases and connecting into bulk power grid at present and for a period of time in the future. Several 10GW-level wind power bases will be built in Hebei, Jiangsu, Inner Mongolia, Gansu, Xinjiang, Jilin according to the development plan made by National Development and Reform Commission, and some of these bases will be connected to power grid via 500kV or even 750kV lines. Consequently, the interaction between wind power and power system become greater. Since wind power has the characteristics of randomness, variability, intermittence, unpredictability and uncontrollability, the integration of wind power will inevitably bring some impact on the plan and operation of power system. The deployment of reactive power devices in wind power collection substation will help to improve the voltage stability of local power grid, to avoid the large-scale trip-off of wind turbines and to improve the capability of substation to exporting wind power. As to the development mode of wind power in China, this paper conducts a study on reactive power compensation of 500kV wind power collection substation in large wind power base. Principle that determines the capacity and type of reactive power devices will be developed considering the active power change and reactive power characteristics of wind power base. The type of dynamic compensation devices will be analyzed based on transient stability analysis. Finally, the technical requirements and control strategy of reactive power compensation devices in wind power collecting substation will be given.

articleTitle: Voltage profile optimization of active distribution network through a distributed approach
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: The increasing proliferation of distributed energy resources on distribution systems has brought a number of network management and operational challenges; voltage variations have been identified as one of the dominant effects. Active distribution network management schemes organize the networks in an active approach through coordinating and controlling local controllable resources. A novel distributed voltage control strategy is proposed in this paper employing a multiple agent system platform. By utilizing local measurements and communications, the proposed voltage control strategy can realize the overall network voltage management and distributed generation maximization simultaneously. A testing arising from the applications of the voltage control strategy on a case study network is carried out at the end of the paper. The feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed voltage control strategy has been demonstrated.

articleTitle: Study of transmission capacity calculation method under high voltage security constraint
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: The integration to weak power grid of large scale wind farm will decrease the margin of voltage stability and increase the difficulty of voltage control. The grid actual operation exposes a new characteristic that the wind turbines trip off since low voltage firstly and high voltage secondly. Based on the power characteristics of wind turbine under LVRT, this paper explains that the root cause of high voltage after grid fault is that wind turbines' active power cannot recover together with voltage synchronously. According to the network structure characteristics of wind power collection area, a network equivalent method for wind power collection area is proposed, which is suitable for the analysis of voltage changing. The relationship between the PCC's voltage rise and the power drop is deduced under the constant power characteristics of wind turbines. A kind of transmission capacity calculation method under high voltage constraint is also proposed. Finally based on actual system, the validity of this method is proved through the comparison of numerical calculation and simulation.

articleTitle: Design of multi-link interactive system in smart grid
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: The concept of interactive load was proposed in this paper. The renewable energy consumption can be achieved in a wide range by matching the energy output with the interactive loads. Firstly, the theories, methods and technologies of comprehensive interaction among generation, transmission, distribution and consumption were introduced. Then a new operation mode of power gird was proposed, through the constructions of transmission interactive platform and distribution interactive platform. The two-way communication network was built to support the platforms to achieve the depth perception, accurate prediction and intelligent decision of each part. Finally, the integrated demonstration project with comprehensive interaction was constructed in Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region. The interactions between each link, including traditional generators, concentrated renewable energy, industrial consumers, transmission network and distribution network, were realized on the transmission interactive platform. The interactions between grid and various loads, such as charging and swapping stations of electric vehicles, smart residential districts, and microgrid, were developed on the distribution interactive platform. The demonstration shows that the proposed interactive operation mode can enhance the consumption ability of renewable energy, can promote the levels of safety, economy and environment of power gird.

articleTitle: Predictive control of wind power ramping based on wind turbine load optimization
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: A predictive control strategy considering ramping rate and power deviation is proposed, which is based on wind turbine load optimization. The wind turbine load model is established according to blade element momentum (BEM) theory, and the influence factors of wind turbine load are analysed based on this model. The control strategy is divided into 3 modules. The prediction module is based on ultra-short-term neural network wind speed prediction. The online optimization model is established with the objectives of minimizing the ramping rate, wind turbine load and power deviation. The feedback module compensates the deviation of optimal control under practical operation conditions. Simulation results show that the proposed strategy can improve the security and economy of wind turbines when dealing with ramping events.

articleTitle: Combined wind speed model based on real wind data
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: As the interest towards wind energy becomes a great concern, it's significant to model wind speed accurately and smoothly for the simulation of wind power system in laboratory. In view of this, an improved wind speed model with 4 components has been established by Matlab/Simulink platform, which shows well performance in describing real wind characteristics of gust, gradual change wind and random noise wind. To further testify its accuracy and reliability, it's indispensible to consider real wind conditions. Based on the wind speed data in YunNan Province of China, a comprehensive model system has been built. Compared with random noise wind speed model, the results show that the 4-component composite wind speed model can provide a more desirable modelling to simulate real situation of gust, gradual change wind and random noise wind. Therefore, combined wind speed model can be an effective and practical part in the wind power experimental platform.

articleTitle: Optimal power dispatch with diverse generation resources considering multi-pollutant emission coordination
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: Power industry contributes much to the air pollution. The share of gas-fired power plants, renewable generators and pumped-hydro storages are rapidly growing, and may become major parts of future generation mix in China. In the new conditions, the combined operation and dispatch of diverse generation resources considering multi-pollutant emission coordination is critical and urgent. Therefore, this paper proposes an integrated optimization model, which is formulated as a mixed integer quadratic constrained program (MIQCP) problem, to jointly dispatch various types of generation resources, including the coal-fired and natural gas-fired power plants, wind farms, solar stations and pumped-hydro storages.
