articleTitle: Comparison and analysis of PV station dynamic reactive power performance testing method
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: When the electric power system transient fault occurs, it will cause the Photovoltaic (PV) power station large-scale off-grid problems, if the PV power station doesn't have low voltage ride through and dynamic reactive power compensation function. It is seriously affecting the safety and stability of power grid. Therefore, the grid-connected PV power station is required the dynamic reactive power support ability. Limited to the testing device capacity, it can't meet the demand of site dynamic reactive power testing, so that the PV power station needs to carry out the dynamic reactive power response performance test method research. The paper analyses of the different field testing method for PV power station dynamic reactive power, and combining with field measured data and the simulation results. Then, this paper presents a method of dynamic reactive power response performance which is applicable for PV power station, through comparing the feasibility of different testing method.

articleTitle: Failure prediction method of gearbox based on BP neural network with genetic optimization algorithm
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: A gearbox is one of the components of double-fed wind turbine which owns the longest downtime and highest maintenance cost. The difficulty of failure prediction of a gearbox based on data is the practical verification of prediction methods. In this paper, a failure prediction method based on the data of vibration feature trend was proposed for a gearbox. The feature values reflecting the condition of a gearbox were extracted through the measured vibration signals. The BP neural network prediction model was established with feature values of a period of time. The structure of BP neural network was optimized by genetic optimization algorithm. The training speed was improved and the prediction error was reduced. The proposed method was verified with practical measured data.

articleTitle: Control strategy research of Doubly-fed induction wind generators based on novel reactive power optimization control
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: As the most widely used wind turbine generating system, the Doubly-fed induction generators, whose output characteristics is worth studying in depth when connected to the grid. In order to study output characteristics of Doubly-fed wind turbines, simulate the response characteristics of the units' main parameters under different wind conditions with the aid of Bladed software. The establishment of linear model which includes wind wheel, drive chain and electrical linear model seeks to obtain linear model of Doubly-fed wind turbines. Then we can obtain transfer function between pitch angle and the reactive power of rotor side using the resulting linear model. Take advantage of Matlab simulation software to build a simulation platform. Moreover, we finally obtain a good rotor reactive response by designing PI controller.

articleTitle: Decentralized on-site optimization of a battery storage system using one-way communication
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: Intermittent renewable energy sources (e.g. wind, solar energy systems) have been providing an exponentially growing share of electricity generation. Due to their highly transient and stochastic nature, they pose substantial challenges for power grid operation. Power dispatched from these sources are uncontrolled and do not necessarily coincide with demand; this in turn affects power quality. Hence, extensive demand side management (DSM) is required. DSM relies on flexible loads as well as energy storage facilities. Furthermore, renewable power generation is by its very nature highly distributed and consists of large numbers of small units. These have a substantial effect on traditional power grid operation and electricity pricing patterns. In this paper, a concept of unidirectional, decentralized, onsite optimization of a battery storage system is presented. A mathematical model of the battery storage system is used to simulate battery dynamics. Battery operation is driven by an optimization procedure, which relies on a one-way communicated pseudo-cost function (PCF). Currently, day-ahead stock market electricity prices are used as the PCF. Optimal operation of the battery is carried out by finding a control function that minimizes the pseudo costs, or maximizes profits.

articleTitle: Research on the reactive power control of wind turbines and dynamic reactive compensation equipment in high-voltage trip-off accident
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: This paper proposed an explanation on a special phenomenon of voltage change during a large-scale trip-off accident of wind turbine generators (WTGs), which occurred in North China on May 14, 2012. In this accident, the local voltage rose slowly from 209kV to 242kV in 5 seconds after a small-capacity capacitor was switched on. As a result, hundreds of WTGs tripped off due to high voltage. The slow rising process of voltage in this accident is remarkably different from the common feature of voltage change under capacitor switching disturbances. Firstly, the main process of this high voltage trip-off accident is analysed, and the correlation between the change of active power/reactive power and the rise in voltage is discussed. It can be drawn that the voltage rising process was mainly because of the change of reactive power. Secondly, a model of wind-integrated power system is built in DIgSILENT/ PowerFactory. The impact of reactive power control mode of doubly fed induction generators (DFIGs) and static var generators (SVGs) on the voltage change are simulated. The simulation results indicate that both SVGs and DFIGs in constant reactive power control mode can lead to a slow rise in voltage. Furthermore, it is demonstrated that the rise rate of voltage depends on the dynamic response time of WTGs and dynamic reactive compensation equipment. In consideration of the low operation ratio of dynamic reactive compensation equipment at that time, the main reason of this high-voltage trip-off accident is WTGs worked in constant power control mode.

articleTitle: Modelling of special protection systems for power system dynamic simulations
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: Special protection systems (SPSs) are very important for the safety and stability of large-scale power systems. A more accurate assessment of system security can be achieved if SPS models are constructed to conform to the actual situation of power grids. However, it is difficult to realistically simulate the performance of SPSs for a large-scale power system. Based on virtual relays and ladder diagrams, this paper proposes a general modelling method for SPSs that conforms to their actual characteristics. Moreover, the full dynamic calculations including these models can be realized using this approach. The modelling process is significantly simplified and the computing work is considerably reduced using the new method. The results show that the simulation program, including the SPS models, can more accurately represent the dynamic performance of a power system after a disturbance, especially during cascading outages caused by power flow transfers. The method can be a useful tool for accurately analyzing the dynamic stability of power systems.

articleTitle: Short-term load forecasting based on human body amenity indicator and arithmetic of random forests
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: In recent years, fog and haze are now becoming common in China, which produces unfavorable influence on the production and life of the residents, and further influences the electricity load and its trend. The severe air condition presents a challenge to power system short-term load forecasting. In this paper, air quality is brought into the comfortable degree index, which is used to power system short-term load forecasting during fog and haze occurrence. Basing on existing human body amenity indicator, a new concept of human body amenity considering AQI, temperature, humidity and wind is presented while analytic hierarchy process (AHP) is used to construct the human comfort index model. In short-term load forecasting, the human comfort index instead of various meteorological factors is taken as input, thus improving the precision of the power load forecast. The similar load days needed in power load forecasting are extracted by using the gray correlation analysis method, and based on that, the arithmetic of random forests is adopted in building forecasting model. The effectiveness and validity of proposed model and algorithm are verified by a city's practical load data and weather data of winter in North China area.

articleTitle: Studies on fault characteristics and protection strategies of MTDC system with DC hub
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: Renewable energy power generation is developing fast in recent years, thereinto wind power generation is one of the most mature and feasible technologies, especially the offshore wind power is the future trend of wind power development. However, the integration of large-scale wind power will bring various challenges and affect the safe operation of power grids. Compared to AC system, multi-terminal DC (MTDC) system can solve these problems better and is more suitable for this application. Thus, the integration of wind power through MTDC system is considered as one of effective technical solutions. Accordingly, the studies on fault characteristics and protection strategies of MTDC system are becoming urgent and important. This paper presents a topology of MTDC system with DC hub which is suitable for wind power collection and transmission of large offshore wind farms, and the fault characteristics of this MTDC system against open-circuit faults are analysed in detail. Furthermore, the corresponding fault protection strategies for the MTDC system are proposed, and the simulations of the MTDC system with DC hub are carried out using the PSCAD/EMTDC simulation tool to verify the feasibility and validity of the above protection strategies.

articleTitle: DC/DC converter for offshore DC collection grid
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: Offshore wind represents a significant clean energy resource. Current offshore wind farm designs use a conventional AC collection network in which the wind-turbine AC output voltage is stepped up to a medium-voltage suitable for wide area connection. A DC offshore collection grid offers an attractive alternative to an AC architecture as it avoids the charging current issues associated with its AC counterpart, and offers the potential for lower system-level losses and reduced size and weight. Such DC architectures depend on high-power DC/DC converter to step up the wind-generator DC output to a voltage compatible with efficient interconnection. This paper proposes an alternative DC collection network based around modular DC/DC converters, realised through parallel-series connection of multiple low-power rated modules. Besides, a bi-directional DC/DC converter is also involved to perform the black start operation of the wind turbine.

articleTitle: An analysis of battery demand capacity of wind/storage system and control of state of charge
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: Based on the control of battery smoothing output with wind power prediction, the calculation method for battery demand capacity is discussed in this paper. And the battery demand capacity based on the wind power prediction is compared with that in the situation without the wind power prediction. By analyzing the characteristics of power output and load fluctuation of the wind farm, based on day-ahead wind power prediction and load prediction, the state of charge (SOC) optimization model is established, and the particle swarm optimization (PSO) is used to solve the model. According to the analysis of examples, the reference index is obviously improved through the optimization. Finally, a battery control strategy based on ultra-short-term predicted wind power correction is proposed, the effectiveness and feasibility of this method is verified by the actual wind power output data and simulation results with PSCAD.

articleTitle: Johnson system based reliability evaluation of composite power system with wind farms
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: With the increasing integration of wind farms, not only the fluctuation of wind power, but also the correlations among wind farms should be considered in power system reliability evaluation. A Johnson system based non-sequential Monte Carlo simulation method for reliability evaluation of composite power system with wind farms is proposed. If distribution function of wind speed is not known, but historical data of wind velocity are given, the relationship between standard normal distribution and wind speed distribution can be constructed by Johnson system. Then, arbitrary amount of wind speed samples with specific correlations can be obtained by normal distribution and Johnson system. Correlation matrix is proven to be nonnegative, and singular value decomposition (SVD) is used to decompose the correlation matrix, which overcomes the drawback that Cholesky decomposition (CD) can't be applied to non-positive matrix. The accuracy of the Johnson system is shown in the following diagram and validity of the proposed algorithm is verified by the case study in the modified IEEE RTS-24 system.

articleTitle: A novel single phase high step-up buck-boost inverter for PV AC module
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: A novel single phase buck-boost step-up inverter for PV AC module is presented in this paper. To begin with, the paper analyzes the inverter's operation principle, control strategy and steady-state characteristics in detail. What's more, the validity of the theoretical analysis has been verified by the simulation results of a 250W/40kHz prototype. The measured THD of grid-connected current is 4.01% and the maximum efficiency is 98.4%. The analytical and simulation investigations show that: if the unipolar frequency doubling SPWM method is adopted, the proposed inverter can effectively boost the DC link voltage to ensure the achievement of grid-connected power generation, and it has the advantages of simple structure, easy to control, and high efficiency.

articleTitle: A combination forecasting model based on IOWA operator for PV generation
publicationTitle: International Conference on Renewable Power Generation (RPG 2015)
abstract: This study presents a method as a method for predicting the output of photovoltaic power station using a combination forecasting model based on IOWA operator. The prediction experiment is conducted based on the operational data of 18kWp grid-connected PV plant in the Power Electronics Research Center of Huazhong University of Science and Technology. In this method, firstly, we employ the grey relational analysis to determine the meteorological environment factors with the highest impact on photovoltaic power generation. Secondly, IOWA combination forecasting model prediction based on each individual sample interval in the fitting accuracy of each point in time the level of empowerment in order to minimize the error sum of squares objective function is established for the combination forecasting model. Finally, we predict the output of photovoltaic power station. The experiment results have verified the validity of this method, and it can provide references for PV power station in generation management.
